import hashlib,json,subprocess,tarfile
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
base=Path("/home/mekashirskiy/projection-transport-steering/artifacts/selection/irc_baseline_v3")
source=Path("/home/mekashirskiy/projection-transport-steering/tmp/irc-baseline-v3")
config_path=source/"research/irc-baseline-config-v3.json"
assert hashlib.sha256(config_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="61529de3e7cf2e865d147ca11e54388590bb50e12d8702c388adb2ed7702f7be"
config=json.loads(config_path.read_text())
dispatch=(base/"dispatch.jsonl").read_bytes()
assert dispatch==(base/"zero-capture-v1/dispatch.jsonl").read_bytes()
records=[json.loads(line) for line in dispatch.splitlines()]
assert len(records)==8 and [r["index"] for r in records]==list(range(8))
observations=[]
fit_files={}
streams={}
for record in records:
    cid=record["container_id"]
    info=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["sudo","-n","docker","inspect",cid],text=True,timeout=20))[0]
    assert info["Id"]==cid and info["Image"]==config["runtime_identity"]["image"]
    assert info["RestartCount"]==0 and not info["State"]["OOMKilled"]
    logs=subprocess.run(["sudo","-n","docker","logs",cid],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=20)
    events=[json.loads(line) for line in logs.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("{")]
    fit=[e for e in events if e.get("event")=="fit_update"]
    index=record["index"]
    directory=base/f"candidate_{index:02d}/run"
    if len(fit)!=564 or not (directory/"adapter.pt").is_file() or not (directory/"selection").is_dir():
        print(json.dumps({"status":"FIT_COMPONENT_NOT_YET_COMPLETE","index":index,"fit_updates":len(fit),"state":info["State"]["Status"]}),flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(2)
    rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (directory/"fit.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    assert rows==[{k:v for k,v in e.items() if k!="event"} for e in fit]
    assert [r["update"] for r in rows]==list(range(1,565))
    for name in ("fit.jsonl","adapter.pt"):
        path=directory/name
        assert path.stat().st_size>0
        fit_files[str(path.relative_to(base))]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    selection=[e for e in events if e.get("event")=="selection_chunk" and e.get("condition")=="selection"]
    observations.append({**record,"state":info["State"],"restarts":info["RestartCount"],"fit_updates":len(fit),"selection_completed":selection[-1]["completed"] if selection else 0,"selection_directory_exists":True,"stdout_fit_join":True,"producer_terminal_receipt_exists":(directory/"receipt.json").exists()})
    streams[f"candidate_{index:02d}-inspect.json"]=json.dumps(info,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n"
    streams[f"candidate_{index:02d}-stdout.log"]=logs.stdout
    streams[f"candidate_{index:02d}-stderr.log"]=logs.stderr
capture=base/"fit-capture-v1"
archive=base/"fit-complete-v1.tar"
inventory_path=base/"fit-complete-v1-inventory.jsonl"
assert not capture.exists() and not archive.exists() and not inventory_path.exists()
now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
for row in observations:
    row["container_to_capture_upper_bound_seconds"]=(now-datetime.fromisoformat(row["state"]["StartedAt"])).total_seconds()
manifest={"schema":"irc-baseline-v3-complete-fit-component-capture","timestamp":now.isoformat(),"config_sha256":hashlib.sha256(config_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"source_sha256":config["source_sha256"],"fit_allocation_sha256":config["packet_sha256"],"workers":observations,"fit_files_sha256":fit_files,"all_fit_updates":4512,"all_candidates":8,"producer_fit_receipts_available":False,"whole_baseline_terminal":False,"input_receipt_is_producer_terminal":False,"frozen_science_changed":False}
capture.mkdir()
streams["fit-input-manifest.json"]=json.dumps(manifest,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n"
streams["dispatch.jsonl"]=dispatch.decode()
for name,content in streams.items():
    with (capture/name).open("x") as handle:
        handle.write(content)
files=[base/name for name in sorted(fit_files)]+sorted(capture.iterdir())
inventory=[]
with tarfile.open(archive,"x") as handle:
    for path in files:
        content=path.read_bytes()
        relative=str(path.relative_to(base))
        digest=hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
        if relative in fit_files:
            assert digest==fit_files[relative]
        inventory.append({"path":relative,"bytes":len(content),"sha256":digest})
        handle.add(path,arcname=relative,recursive=False)
for name,digest in fit_files.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((base/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
with inventory_path.open("x") as handle:
    for row in inventory:
        handle.write(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS_COMPLETE_FIT_CAPTURE_NOT_EFFICACY","timestamp":manifest["timestamp"],"archive":str(archive),"archive_bytes":archive.stat().st_size,"archive_sha256":hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"inventory":str(inventory_path),"inventory_sha256":hashlib.sha256(inventory_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"files":len(inventory),"fit_files":len(fit_files),"updates":4512,"workers":[{"index":r["index"],"state":r["state"]["Status"],"fit_updates":r["fit_updates"],"selection_completed":r["selection_completed"],"producer_terminal_receipt_exists":r["producer_terminal_receipt_exists"]} for r in observations]}),flush=True)
